title: Guessing Steps (deterministic)
prompt: secret = 7 is given, and guesses = [4, 9, 7] simulates the player. Walk the guesses in order with a for loop and print each guess, stopping (break) the moment the secret is found. The winning guess must be printed too.

tests.name: walks and stops at the hit
tests.code:
assert printed == ["4", "9", "7"], f"got {printed}"
assert "break" in code, "break once the secret is found"
tests.hint: for g in guesses: print(g); if g == secret: break — print before checking.
